description: Lift the labeled drive housings to discover concealed tray and seal motion before deployment. Opened housings stay visible. Bench inspection safely previews only the startup segment; later drive pairs appear during the live relay. Record a sweep from CATCH to PASS. Deploy your recorded workers and correct their hand heights as trays and seal heads move. Click each moving passport at OUT before it crosses the exit line. Clear all three passports. A missed catch, seal, pass or pickup, or an uncollected departing passport, ends the episode.
